verdict.rationale: ROS 2 provides rosbag2 recording plus a documented Python API to read/write bag data for offline processing (ros2-docs-17, ros2-docs-23), which supports the 'collect and analyze offline' part of the story. However, the evidence never mentions SQL querying capability or a dedicated query/export API (rosbag2's SQLite backend isn't discussed), so the SQL/API-query angle is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit SQL query support/documentation, a dedicated data-export API beyond raw bag read/write, and independent confirmation of ease-of-use for offline analysis.
